items.title: Chip Stocks Face a Long Climb Back to Their Peak Despite Recent Rally
items.summary: The PHLX Semiconductor Index has roared back to life, climbing more than 18% from its recent low on July 29. Yet it still has a long way to go to reclaim its summertime highs. Following last month's sharp decline, the index—consisting of names like Nvidia, Micron Technology, and Broadcom—needs an additional 18.
